title: Vingroup’s Hospitality Arm Seeks $300 Million in Private Debt
content: The hospitality unit of Vingroup JSC is seeking a private credit loan of as much as $300 million for refinancing, people familiar with the matter said, the latest in a series of borrowings raised by the Vietnamese conglomerate.

title: A Tiny Bank Runs Dry of Borrowers as Population Shrinks in Japan
content: Many Japanese banks in the countryside are struggling due to a shrinking population, but at a tiny credit union in the northernmost tip of the country, the situation is extreme.

title: Stocks Bounce From Lows on Hopes for US-Iran Talks | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 3/24/2026
content: On today's episode of Bloomberg Businessweek Daily, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec discuss broader market reaction amid more back and forth about US-Iran talks. Ray Takeyh from the Council on Foreign Relations and former US Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross join the show to discuss. Then, Bloomberg Tech Co-Hosts Ed Ludlow and Caroline Hyde sit down with Applied Intuition CTO and co-founder Peter Ludwig to discuss the company's tech partnerships in the defense space. Then, Bloomberg Leveraged Finance reporters Ellen DiMauro and Olivia Fishlow join to discuss more private credit stress at Cliffwater. Also, live remarks from President Trump as he delivers live remarks from the White House, saying Iran has offered a "present" as a show of good faith in negotiations. (Source: Bloomberg)
